name: airtable
description: Read and write operational data in Airtable — query, search, create, update, and delete records; manage tables, fields, and record comments; automate any routine Airtable workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, fields, records, and comments through an MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Airtable skill exposes the airtable-mcp-server by domdomegg as a single Fractal toolset. It speaks the official Airtable Web API using a Personal Access Token, so every tool call is a real Airtable operation. Use it to discover bases and schemas, list / search / create / update / delete records, manage tables and fields, and post or read record comments. Perfect for CRMs, project trackers, content calendars, applicant pipelines, and lightweight back-office apps. Authenticate by setting AIRTABLE_API_KEY in the workspace environment.
defaultPrompt: Use the Airtable skill whenever the task involves querying, searching, creating, updating, or deleting records in an Airtable base.
Always discover the schema first — call list_bases → list_tables → describe_table before reading or writing records.
Prefer server-side filterByFormula in list_records over fetching every record and filtering locally.
